sources.title: Hydroponic Ganja seizure at Chennai International Airport
sources.excerpt: Based on Passenger profiling, officers of the Air Intelligence Unit (AIU), Chennai Customs intercepted an Indian male passenger, who had arrived at Chennai International Airport from Dubai on 13 September 2026. sources.excerpt: The Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS), Chennai Branch Office organised “MANAK SAMVAAD – Sensitization Meeting with New BIS Licensees” at its Chennai Campus on 11 September 2026. sources.title: India to host World Circular Economy Forum 2026, themed 'Circular Economy: Transition for People and Prosperity', at Gandhinagar during 15th - 18th September, 2026
sources.excerpt: India would host the World Circular Economy Forum (WCEF) 2026, at Gandhinagar (Gujarat) on 15th-18th September, 2026. A First for South Asia, the forum would be jointly inaugurated on the 15th by Union Minister for Environment, Forest and Climate Change, Shri Bhupender Yadav, and Chief Minister of Gujarat, Shri Bhupendrabhai Patel. The forum would be organised under the theme 'Circular Economy: Transition for People and Prosperity'. Other dignitaries to grace the inaugural session would include Minister for Forest, Environment and Climate Change (Gujarat), Shri Arjunbhai Modhwadia; Ambassador of Finland to India, H.E. Mr. Mikko Kivikoski; Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate (Netherlands), Ms. Marieke Spijkerboer, along with senior officials from the Government of India and Government of Gujarat.

sources.author: Ministry of Coal
sources.title: Coal Supply to Punjab Power Plants Remains Adequate; Timely Lifting from CIL and Higher Captive Coal Utilisation Key to Sustained Generation
sources.excerpt: Media reports today, including one titled “Punjab power crisis deepens as 14-hour cuts hit factories, farms,” have attributed reduced power generation at Punjab's thermal plants towards plant outages and inadequate coal supply. The Ministry of Coal clarifies that this does not present the complete picture. Adequate coal has been made available to Punjab's power plants, and Coal India Limited (CIL) remains fully committed to ensuring uninterrupted coal supply for power generation across the country, including in Punjab.

sources.author: PIB Backgrounder
sources.title: Incentive Scheme for Promotion of Domestic PNG Connections
sources.excerpt: Piped Natural Gas (PNG) expansion is an important part of India’s transition towards cleaner household energy and energy security. Supplying PNG to homes is part of City Gas Distribution (CGD) network development. Such a network comprises pipelines and allied facilities that serve households, commercial establishments, and industrial units. Entities authorised by the Petroleum and Natural Gas Regulatory Board (PNGRB) develop it. PNGRB has authorised entities in 309 Geographical Areas (GAs) . Together, these areas span the entire mainland of the country. As of 18 August 2026, there were 1.74 crore domestic PNG connections across the country.

sources.title: Dryland Congress 2026 Concludes with Delhi Declaration on Drylands
sources.excerpt: The three-day Dryland Congress 2026 concluded today in New Delhi with a strong call for greater South–South and triangular cooperation to accelerate solutions for dryland agriculture. The final day coincided with the United Nations Day for South–South Cooperation and culminated in the adoption of the Delhi Declaration on Drylands (3D), setting out a shared agenda for transforming dryland agriculture through collaboration, knowledge exchange, innovation and collective action across the Global South. It was endorsed at the closing plenary by participating governments, institutions, partners and delegates of the Dryland Congress 2026.
